faqs.q: Is it really a one-time payment?
faqs.a: Yes. You pay 9.99 € once and your account becomes Pro for life. No automatic renewals, no monthly or annual billing.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on smart links or QRs in Pro?
faqs.a: No. With Pro you can create unlimited smart links and QRs for different apps, campaigns, channels or locations.

faqs.q: What happens to the links I created on the Free plan?
faqs.a: They stay live and keep working. Upgrading to Pro unlocks advanced analytics, custom slugs and unlimited links.

faqs.q: Can I change a link's destination without reprinting the QR?
faqs.a: Yes. Smart links are stable: you can change the App Store, Google Play or fallback URL anytime and the printed QR keeps working.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: You can pay with card, Apple Pay or Google Pay depending on your device. The transaction is handled securely by our payment processor.

faqs.q: Can I invoice the payment to my company?
faqs.a: Yes. After payment you get a receipt and we can issue a tax invoice with your company details on request.

items.question: What exactly does Link My App do?
items.answer: Link My App creates one link for your app. When someone opens it, it detects iPhone, Android or another device and sends the user to the right destination.

items.question: Can I create multiple links for the same app?
items.answer: Yes. You can create different links for campaigns, locations or channels and see where clicks come from.

items.question: Does it generate a QR code too?
items.answer: Yes. Each download link can generate a QR code for posters, packaging, counters, events or physical campaigns.

items.question: What happens if the user opens it from a computer?
items.answer: Then Link My App uses the fallback link you define, such as a download landing page, info page or website.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
items.answer: No. Paste the App Store link, the Google Play link, choose the name you want and create your download link.
